```plato

//==
// # Shadows, masking, and auxiliary light settings
//
// The per-light controls that accompany the emitters above without
// being emitters themselves: shadow-map rendering, layer masking, measured
// photometric profiles, and participating-media scattering. Distances and radii
// are unit-agnostic scene Numbers.

// Shadow-map rendering controls for one light. Resolution is the shadow map
// edge length in pixels. Bias and NormalBias offset depth comparisons along
// the view ray and surface normal to prevent acne. PenumbraSize scales
// soft-shadow width. CascadeCount splits a directional shadow into successive
// depth ranges (1 = no cascades). MaxDistance is the farthest shadowed
// distance in scene units. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shadow_mapping)
type ShadowSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Resolution: Integer;
    Bias: Number;
    NormalBias: Number;
    PenumbraSize: Number;
    CascadeCount: Integer;
    MaxDistance: Number;
}
```
